name: testvdb
description: 基于 LLM 的向量数据库自动化缺陷挖掘工具。支持 Milvus/Qdrant/Weaviate/PGVector 四种向量数据库，通过自然语言契约逆向工程从官方文档提取结构化约束，结合多 Agent 辩论机制在 Docker 沙箱中自动发现合规性缺陷。

requirements.network: WebFetch 被某些文档站点封锁。Crawl4AI 本地 Docker 服务作为首要网页抓取方案 (docker/crawl4ai.yml)。WebFetch 保留作为降级备选。
requirements.docker: Docker CLI commands (pull/manifest inspect) work without authentication. Docker Hub REST API for tag listing has anonymous rate limits — set DOCKER_HUB_TOKEN for higher limits. Crawl4AI container requires ~2GB shared memory (shm_size). Security: Crawl4AI runs in isolated Docker container with no host network access. All web scraping is restricted to documentation sites only.
requirements.python: 3.9+ with httpx, html2text, requests (pip install httpx html2text requests)
requirements.security: Scripts execute in resource-limited Docker containers (--memory=1g --cpus=2). No privileged containers. No host network access. All tokens via environment variables.
